subtitle: 공항에서 렌터카 계약하고 보험·반납 확인하기
desc: 공항 렌터카 데스크에서 예약 확인, 보험, 주유, 반납 장소를 묻는 회화

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Hi. I have a reservation under the name Park.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.en: Good afternoon. May I see your driver's license and a credit card?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Sure. Here they are. It's a compact car for three days, right?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.en: That's right. Would you like full coverage insurance? It's twenty dollars a day.

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Yes, please. I want full coverage.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.en: Okay. Please return the car with a full tank. There's a gas station just outside the lot.
turns.ko: 알겠습니다. 기름을 가득 채워서 반납해 주세요. 주차장 바로 밖에 주유소가 있어요.

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Got it. Where should I return the car on Friday?
turns.ko: 알겠어요. 금요일에 차는 어디에 반납하면 되나요?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.en: Same counter. Drop-off is on the first floor of the parking garage.

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Is there a GPS in the car?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.en: Yes. The keys are on the counter. Have a safe drive.
turns.ko: 네. 열쇠는 카운터에 두었습니다. 안전 운전하세요.

Would you like full coverage insurance?
Please return the car with a full tank.
Where should I return the car?
